basic_info.description: This stately vacant two-unit Edwardian, spanning 3,190 square feet across three levels, combines historic elegance with modern updates in the heart of the Mission. The property features an over-sized two-car garage, a sun-filled rear yard /patio, and a separate carriage house with vintage carriage! Offering two spacious residential flats each with a renovated kitchen featuring quartz counters and stainless appliances, 1 bathroom, classic Edwardian detailing, rear decks, parking, and yard access; the building is available as a grand compound ideal for partners or an extended family, and as individual Tenancies-in-Common. The carriage house may have potential for an ADU? 1384 has 2 beds and 1 bath on one level and 1386 has 3 bedrooms and 1 bath on two levels. Large fully fenced rear yard/patio. Perfectly positioned with access to both Potrero Hill and the Mission, near 24th Street, Potrero del Sol Park, Precita Park, and San Francisco General Hospital, this is a rare opportunity to own a distinctive property in a prime Mission location.
